cases.title: Record Visited Link to Global History
cases.description: Verify that a visited link is successfully recorded to the Global History.

cases.title: Record Full URL with Query Parameters and Fragments
cases.description: Verify that visiting a page with query parameters or fragments correctly records the full URL in the Global History.

analysis.analysis: Unit: firefox_browser_history. Requirement R-073 (Normal): Visited link is successfully recorded in Global History. R-073 (Edge): Visiting a page with query parameters or fragments correctly records the full URL. R-074 (Normal): Final destination URL after server redirect is recorded to Global History. R-074 (Edge): Multiple consecutive redirects (301/302) record the final target URL. R-075 (Normal): Clicking a history link opens it in a browser window. R-076 (Normal): Single history entry is deleted. R-077 (Normal): Multiple history entries are selected and deleted, removing them from display. R-078 (Normal): Entire Global History is cleared. R-079 (Normal): History items are grouped by Day, Site, and None options. R-080 (Normal): History columns are sorted and reverse-sorted. R-081 (Normal): History columns are resizable to show or hide more entry text. R-082 (Normal): History columns are explicitly shown and hidden. R-083 (Normal): Recently visited sites are revisited via Back and Forward button dropdown menus. R-084 (Normal): A new, empty session history file is created upon opening a new browser window or application restart.
